lines.show: One kid even got a dragon
And the richest family in town
Dragons even have their own traffic lights.
My best friend got a red dragon
that can fly faster than a {y:plane.}
and it was as big as a mountain.
Every day, Blake flew over my house
and dropped his ice cream on me.
I kept it warm with a {y:hair dryer.}
I showed it pictures of other dragons.
I even put it in the {r:microwave.}
and becomes the hero of the town.
Every dragon in town signed up.
Blake said I could join if I wanted.
But the night before the race,
Blake was crying under a table.
But my dragon wasn't scared of the storm.
and we flew straight into the storm.
Titan was too tired to fly.
Turns out my dragon wasn't late.
